3. Rolled back to `v2.3.0` in all production regions — completed successfully.

transcript.content:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. Checked status: `checkout-api` was on `v2.3.1`, unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with a 0.18 error rate.
2. Reviewed deployment history and identified `v2.3.0` as the most recent version that was healthy in production.
3. Rolled back to `v2.3.0` in all production regions — completed successfully.
4. Opened a SEV2 incident (`INC-0002`) describing the failure and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer.
